about: Two motif appearances on a prop, at no scene. Their natural keys (§6.3) agree except that `scene_id` and `domain` are NULL in both, and NULL key columns compare EQUAL (§6.4): one link, written twice. A reader comparing with SQL's `=` sees two distinct links and reports nothing.

findings.message: 2 identical Motif Appearance rows describe the same link. Harmless, but one of them is noise.
findings.title: Link rows sharing a natural key
